anchor.statement: Lemma 5.4. There are numbers a j+1 ≥ 2a j , with a −1 1 < q 0 , and a fixed smooth cutoff χ , equal to one on [0, 1/2] and zero on [1, ∞ ), such that U = U 0 + ∑ j≥1 (︁ curl( χ (a j q)A j ) + χ (a j q)B j , χ (a j q)p j , χ (a j q)T j )︁ (5.34)

correspondence.by: Christian Garry (drafted with Claude Code; second review by ChatGPT, checked)
correspondence.note: exists_angular_realization gives one schedule a with 2a_j ≤ a_{j+1} and 1/a_j < q0 and a Result for that schedule: smooth, locally finite, divergence-free velocity, equality with the base near q > 1/a_0 (zero extension across q = q0), and the uncut tail bound (1/2)^J q^{g_{J+1}/2 − ℓ'_m} for q < 1/(2a_J) and m ≤ J+2 (J+3 for scalars). Result.flat_residual_of_support_local_raw_bounds, applied to that same Result, gives (5.36) under the coefficient bounds (5.32) on the factor supports and the residual hypothesis (5.33) with a flat remainder; the hypothesis on q is the all-derivative bound |D^k q| ≤ B_k q^{1−k}, which (5.28) implies since D < 1 and q ≤ 1.
